newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SOCCER-ROMANIA CALL UP DUMITRESCU AGAINST MACEDONIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ROMANIA CALL UP DUMITRESCU AGAINST MACEDONIA.

text.p: Romania coach Anghel Iordanescu has called up attacking midfielder Ilie Dumitrescu for Wednesday's World Cup qualifier against Macedonia as he goes all out for the victory that will all but guarantee a place in the 1998 finals.

Romania have the most impressive record in all nine qualifying groups to date, gaining a maximum 18 points by scoring 20 goals and not conceding one. Victory over second-placed Macedonia would leave third-placed Ireland or Lithuania, fourth, needing a miracle to take top spot.

Dumitrescu, now playing for Mexican side Atlante, has not featured since last October's game in Iceland. The 28-year-old was one of Romania's top players in the 1994 World Cup finals but lost form after a move to English side Tottenham.
But he is now back to his attacking best and the absence of three regular midfielders means he is an almost certain starter on Wednesday.
Skipper Gheorghe Hagi and Dorinel Munteanu are both suspended while Ionut Lupescu is refusing to play after being dropped in the last match. Striker Ion Vladoiu is also missing due to injury.
Galatasary midfielder Iulian Filipescu is fighting to overcome an injury and if he does not make it will probably be replaced by Steaua defender Marius Baciu.
Macedonia miss striker Toni Micevskitheir and midfielder Milko Stojkovski, both suspended.
Macedonia coach Djoko Hadjievski, who has called up nine overseas players, said: "The Romanians are a redoubtable team even without Hagi on the field. But we have a chance."

Romania: Bogdan Stelea; Dan Petrescu, Anton Dobos, Daniel Prodan, Tibor Selymess, Gheorghe Popescu, Constantin Galca, Ilie Adrian, Iulian Filipescu (or Marius Baciu), Viorel Moldovan, Ilie Dumitrescu.
Macedonia: Sasa Ilic; Igor Sasa Nikolovski, Goce Sedlovski, Ljupco Markovski, Husein Beganovic, Risto Milosavov, Vlatko Gosev, Viktor Trenevski, Srdan Zaharijevski, Georgi Hristov, Artim Sakiri.
